instruction.text: At the start of May, a book shop had 18,500 books. The shop sold 6,625 books in May and 7,211 books in June. How many books did the shop have left at the end of June?

atoms.b: Books left at the end of June: <mat><gap>18500</gap>-<gap>13836</gap>=?</mat>
Therefore, the shop had <mat><gap>4664</gap></mat> books left at the end of June.

instruction.text: For a concert, a venue has the capacity for 12,000 attendees. Tickets were sold in 2 waves. 5,242 people bought their tickets in the first wave and 3,876 people bought their tickets in the second wave. How many tickets were left over?

At the beginning of autumn, a small town had a stockpile of 24,000 logs of wood. During the autumn, 8,313 logs were used for heating. During winter, a further 13,298 logs were used. How many logs were left over at the end of winter?
